market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed hike, 5% 10Y yield, and oil volatility. Expect choppy, risk-off sessions with sector rotation into energy, defense, and value. AI names volatile but resilient. Crypto weak. Dollar firm. 1-3 months: range-bound with downside risk if oil exceeds $100 or Fed signals further hikes.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 months: If Warsh's inflation fight succeeds, rate cuts resume by Q1 2027, supporting equities. Oil normalization post-pipeline restarts reduces energy premium. AI capex cycle matures into earnings-driven phase. US-China engagement via Trump-Xi could unlock trade de-escalation. Housing correction likely 10-15% in select markets. India and EM remain structural growth plays.
